name: keep-mac-awake
description: Lets your agent keep a MacBook with Apple silicon awake with the lid closed while long tasks run, through the keepmacawake command of the Keep Mac Awake app: it starts a timed session before long work, stops it after, and tells you when the app needs your attention. Requires the Keep Mac Awake app (a 3-day trial, then a one-time purchase per Mac).
